facts.meaning: This commitment object advanced to an index supported by a strict majority of its currently registered voter match values, and that index is at least its configured startIndex. This states reported support, not independently proven durable replication.

identity.membership: voter map at the advancing recalculation

facts.validity_context: Historical calculation at advancement within one commitment object; later membership changes can alter the voter map without decreasing commitIndex.
representation: commitCh notification prompts a fresh read
facts.durability: In-memory derived value; not itself a persisted quorum certificate.
facts.recovery: Fresh commitment allocation resets match indexes and commitIndex; full recovery path is unmapped.
unknowns: Snapshot success producer and restore completion are now mapped; actual store durability, snapshot provenance and leadership-context validity remain unproven.
Match report truth and legal configuration transitions remain obligations to investigate, not assumed facts

facts.meaning: The built-in pipeline decoder has recorded completion status for this request-associated future and published it to Consumer. The status may be an error; readiness alone does not establish a valid successful AppendEntries response.

identity.request: Request pointer captured by pipeline AppendEntries

facts.validity_context: Completion and publication of one in-progress future, prior to consumer inspection.
facts.durability: In-memory completion notification; no independent persistence guarantee.
facts.recovery: Pipeline lifecycle is transient; reconstruction across restart is not asserted.
unknowns: Custom transport producers have not been read; this fact describes the two built-in producers only.
A completed future can contain unusable response data on error; legal partial-decode histories remain unexplored.

facts.meaning: For a successful response produced by installSnapshot, the supplied stream passed exact-size copy and sink Close, the FSM restore future returned nil, and receiver lastApplied, lastSnapshot and configurations were assigned from request metadata before reply. This is completion at that handler, not a guarantee of physical durability or request freshness.

identity.snapshot: Request LastLogIndex/LastLogTerm and newly created sink ID

facts.validity_context: At successful receiver reply; subsequent state changes and restart are not covered.
facts.durability: Conditional on SnapshotStore and FSM contracts; acknowledgment itself is not a durable object.
unknowns: Request provenance and monotone snapshot freshness remain unproven
Log cleanup failure does not prevent success
Sender consumption depends on transport preserving request/reply correspondence
